name: Hospitality English — Can I Work in English? Assessment Import Pack — VERIFIED
design_principles: Measures practical hospitality English rather than academic grammar.
Uses existing app content wherever possible.
Does not claim employment qualification or CEFR certification.
First completed attempt is stored as baseline; latest completed attempt is current.
Results feed weak skills into recommendations, Practice and future Tonight's Shift.
Listening and Speaking can replace selected questions later without changing the six-area score model.

scoring.weak_area_rule: lowest 2 area scores; ties broken by more recent incorrect evidence then fixed area order
scoring.weak_skill_rule: within weak areas, count primary_skill/skills attached to incorrect answers; save up to 3 skill slugs
